en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of his companions, 
from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
regarding the dying woman and the child is moving in her belly, should her belly be split and the child taken out?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, and her belly would be stitched’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from certain persons of his people who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, was asked, ‘If a woman dies with a child moving in her womb, is her belly to be opened to take the child out?’
He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, and her belly is stitched to close.”
